cases.input: Add CSV export to the reports page.
cases.context: Repo has a reports page; the request names no format details, no size limits, no auth constraints.
expected: Runs Step 0 (B1 ambiguity detection) BEFORE writing code — the request maps to multiple interpretations (which columns, streaming vs in-memory, permissions)
Asks one bundled multiple-choice clarification with 2-4 numbered options and a declared default
Reads the issue/specs (Step 1) before producing the implementation plan (Step 2)
forbidden: Starts editing source files before the ambiguity gate resolves
Asks a series of one-off questions across multiple turns instead of one bundled prompt
cases.rubric: PASS iff the agent surfaces the ambiguity gate output (or an explicit no-ambiguity determination) before any file mutation, and any clarification follows the one-question/numbered-options/default shape.

cases.input: Implement the approved plan for the 'saved filters' feature. The feature adds a dropdown to the search bar.
cases.context: Plan approved; feature has a UI surface; repo contains an existing component library.
expected: Invokes hatch3r-design-system-detect (Step 1c) before authoring new UI components
Implements as a vertical slice (data model, domain logic, API, UI) rather than UI-only
Writes tests for the slice (Step 4) and runs the quality gates (Step 5) before declaring done
forbidden: Hand-rolls new UI primitives without the design-system inventory
Declares the feature done without browser verification (Step 5b applies — the feature has UI)
cases.rubric: PASS iff the design-system inventory precedes UI authoring AND the completion claim cites executed tests/gates rather than asserting success without verification.
